name: smwmusic-cindy-open-invitation
title: Cindy - Open Invitation
description:
An arrangement of the 7th Ending theme to Urusei Yatsura, "Open Invitation"
This was originally published on SiIvaGunner under the name
"File Select (Sonic 3 & Knuckles) - Mario is Missing! Done Right."
It uses the instruments and styles of Sonic 3 & Knuckles - File Select by Gamma V
(https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=8517)

‼ MODERATOR NOTE ‼ - If you wish to use the goal variant of this song, be sure to add an ! to mark "default/0F SMW @21.brr" as a global sample, else the song will not work!
